name: Galenwe
related_quests: Woe of the Welkynars: Help a Gryphon Knight defeat a powerful Sea Sload sorceress and save Cloudrest.
summary: Galenwe is one of four Welkynar Knights. During the fall of Cloudrest, he is corrupted by Z'Maja and fights for her as a shadowy clone. If he is defeated alongside Z'Maja in the final battle he is released from her spell and retakes his mortal form. He fights alongside his gryphon companion, Falarielle.
